Name: Coal Regen
Author: BluciferProgrammer
Description:
[size=3][u]Description[/u][/size]
[size=2]Makes the coal carts and coal bags in the mines regenerate. Not entirely lore friendly, but you can pretend there are dwarfs still mining down there.
[/size]
[size=3][u]Install[/u][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=2][url=https://github.com/Pathoschild/SMAPI/releases]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[size=3][u]Configuration[/u][/size]
Run the game with the mod, then open the new config.json in the mod folder.

[b]RegenEveryTime [/b](boolean)
- False (Default) = Regens every second time you visit the floor
- True = Regens every time you visit the floor

[size=3][u]Source[/u][/size]
[url=https://github.com/AbbyNode/StardewValley-CoalRegen]Github[/url]

Downloads.Description: Added config option to regen coal every time instead of every second time.
